notes.title: About Steam Deck Compatibility
notes.content:
This proof-of-concept was designed with the Steam Deck in mind. Therefore, there is a dedicated version of the game for the console. The Steam Deck version of [i]Throw Home[/i] has the following features:

[list]
[*] Default resolution of 1280x800
[*] Button prompts use a visualized Steam Deck model for ease-of-understanding.
[*] Dedicated Steam Deck Controller Configuration
[*] Right Trackpad used as navigation in Menu/Overworld
[/list]

To access it, simply download [i]Throw Home[/i] to your Steam Deck from the Steam Store. Steam will automatically provide you the Steam Deck version of the game.
